Taxon ids to ask the trait table for (internal helper)

dot-trait_group_idtax.Rd

Trait measurements are keyed by the taxon they were recorded on, which may be any member of a synonym group: a name matched to a synonym often has its traits stored on the accepted taxon, or on a sibling synonym.

`query_taxa()` handles this by widening the id set *before* fetching - `.resolve_synonyms()` substitutes the accepted id and binds every synonym of the group into the result, and that whole vector is what reaches `query_taxa_traits()`. `include_synonyms = TRUE` does not do this on its own: inside `query_taxa_traits()` the fetch runs first, on the ids given verbatim, and synonyms are resolved only afterwards - which regroups what came back but can no longer widen the search. Asking for the matched id alone therefore returned nothing at all for any name matched to a synonym.

Usage

.trait_group_idtax(matched_taxa, con_taxa = NULL)

Arguments

matched_taxa

Data frame carrying `idtax_n` and `idtax_good_n`

con_taxa

Connection to the taxa database, or NULL to open one

Value

Integer vector of taxon ids covering the full synonym groups
